text: oh, ok and this changes things a bit, so i can tell the heightfields that are not appearing are actually there, because when i go to place some build pieces, you can tell they are very clearly getting raised because of some invisible hill under it
resolution: The invisible-hill observation was the confirming evidence for req_2708's diagnosis: physics colliders are registered from the raw height grid (world_loader registerHeightfield) on a separate path from the render mesh, so when the dyn geometry tail filled and the render re-bake silently drew the stale mesh, the heights and colliders kept updating — build pieces seat on terrain you cannot see. Fixed by the same 23711c570 change: sculpted heightfields reserve their worst-case region once instead of leaking a region per stroke frame, so render and collider stay in step. Needs a Zig rebuild.
